title: S-decorated Mo2C as efficient catalyst for Li–O2 battery system
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,23819-23826
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02021B, Paper

Yanhong Ding, Zhichao Gao, Rongpeng Lin, Yong Cao, Haoyang Liu, Yulin Zhou, Haifeng Xu, Jiayi Liu, Fangqi Ren, Yirong Zhu
S@Mo2C cathode significantly enhances Li–O2 battery performance: specific capacity 3955 mA h g−1, overpotential 0.26 V, 77.8% capacity retention after 250 cycles. Sulfur doping induces MoS2/MoS3 heterostructure formation, enhances conductivity activity.
